issue.title: provision calls an unreadable worktree clean
issue.body:
`agent_harness.py provision` pointed at an existing worktree whose `git status` fails (a corrupt or unreadable index) reports it as an existing clean worktree. That label invites deleting uncommitted work.

## Done when

- Provisioning refuses such a target and says it is unreadable.
- `uv run --no-sync python3 tests/test_agent_harness.py` passes.
